name: Letter From Xiangling
desc: Xiangling has unexpectedly sent you a letter, its envelope brimming with the warmth and bustle of everyday life. She wants to invite you to Yilong Wharf, and seems to have prepared some sort of surprise...

value.text:
Version 7.1 Event - Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon Prologue: Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around

desc.text: It's been a while, Traveller‍ and Paimon! I've really missed you two! I'm writing because whenever something good happens, I can't help thinking of my friends! If you're free, swing by Yilong Wharf — I've got a surprise waiting for you!
